name: sdp_sqrt2
description: 2x2 SDP: max x_12 s.t. x_11=1, x_22=2, X 2x2 PSD. PSD requires x_12^2 <= x_11*x_22=2, so max x_12=sqrt(2) (irrational). X*=[[1,sqrt(2)],[sqrt(2),2]] is RANK-1 SINGULAR (det=0, boundary optimum). Tests high-precision irrational values.
reference_method: Exact closed form: Cauchy-Schwarz / Schur complement: max x_12 s.t. [[1,x_12],[x_12,2]]>=0 gives x_12<=sqrt(2). Computed Sqrt[2] via N[Sqrt[2],65] in Mathematica.
